mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an imminent monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in residential construction permits below 1300.0 thousand units signals weakening housing demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 109.0 signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 109.0.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit (RSAFS) falls below 500,000 million dollars, it indicates reduced consumer spending capacity, lowering corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 500000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPI inflation above 2.5% and decline in federal funds rate below 2.0% signals a policy response to inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market tightness regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in unemployment rate below 3.4% signals accelerating job market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In labor market tightness regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.4.
